memo.executiveSummary: NordBank AG requires a scalable modern data platform supporting 400 TB of critical risk analytics while strictly adhering to EU data-residency and BaFin regulatory oversight. Telemetry recommends transitioning from the existing multi-tenant cloud warehouse to an EU Private-Cloud deployment of IOMETE running directly within NordBank's own AWS Kubernetes perimeter.
memo.recommendation: Approve a 90-day evaluation of IOMETE Enterprise deployed inside NordBank's AWS Frankfurt VPC, targeting a 3-year projected savings of ~$870,000+ while achieving 100% data sovereignty.
memo.financialSummary: Year 1 estimated platform licensing and infrastructure compute is projected at $231,000 against a current run-rate of $850,000. Over 3 years, projected cumulative expenditure is $764,000 versus an estimated $2,872,000 on the legacy platform, yielding an estimated payback period of under 4 months.

risksAndUnknowns: Peak concurrency during end-of-month regulatory stress testing must be validated during the evaluation.

Run 30-day query benchmarking on top 10 heaviest credit risk pipelines.
Execute formal CISO security and RBAC audit checklist.

The recommended next step is a ninety-day evaluation with IOMETE to validate workload sizing and infrastructure assumptions.
